guarded.EN: That's close enough. What do you want?
guarded.TL: Hanggang diyan ka lang. Ano ang gusto mo?

guarded.EN: Hands where I can see them. Who are you?
guarded.TL: Kamay kung saan ko nakikita. Sino ka?

guarded.EN: Stop right there. State your business.
guarded.TL: Tigil diyan. Sabihin mo ang pakay mo.

guarded.EN: Keep your distance. What brings you over here?
guarded.TL: Panatilihin ang distansya. Anong nagdala sa 'yo rito?

guarded.EN: Don't take another step. Who sent you?
guarded.TL: Huwag ka nang humakbang pa. Sinong nagpadala sa 'yo?

guarded.EN: Stay where you are. Why are you approaching me?
guarded.TL: Diyan ka lang. Bakit ka lumalapit sa akin?

guarded.EN: Hold ground. What are you after?
guarded.TL: Diyan ka lang. Anong hinahabol mo?

guarded.EN: Keep your hands clear of your waist. Who are you?
guarded.TL: Ilayo ang kamay sa baywang. Sino ka?

guarded.EN: One wrong twitch and we have a problem. Speak up.
guarded.TL: Isang maling galaw at magkakaproblema tayo. Magsalita ka.

neutral.EN: Hold up a second. What's your name?
Stop there for a moment. Are you friendly?
neutral.TL: Tigil muna diyan. Kaibigan ka ba?

neutral.EN: Hold on. What brings you to this area?
neutral.TL: Teka muna. Anong ginagawa mo sa lugar na 'to?

neutral.EN: State who you are and what you're doing here.
neutral.TL: Sabihin kung sino ka at anong ginagawa mo rito.

neutral.EN: Hold it right there. Let's talk before you come closer.
neutral.TL: Diyan ka muna. Mag-usap tayo bago ka lumapit pa.

neutral.EN: Who are you and who are you with?
neutral.TL: Sino ka at sinong kasama mo?

neutral.EN: Stop there. Just want to make sure you're not a threat.
neutral.TL: Tigil diyan. Nais ko lang tiyakin na di ka banta.

neutral.EN: Hold up. Give me a name and a reason you're here.
neutral.TL: Teka lang. Bigyan mo ako ng pangalan at dahilan kung bakit ka narito.

warm.EN: Easy. I don't know you yet.
Hold on there, stranger. Let's introduce ourselves first.
warm.TL: Teka muna, estranghero. Magpakilala muna tayo.

warm.EN: Easy does it. Are you alone out here?
warm.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Nag-iisa ka ba rito?

warm.EN: Hey there. Don't be frightened, just tell me your name.
warm.TL: Kumusta. Huwag kang matakot, sabihin mo lang pangalan mo.

warm.EN: Slow down, friend. Let's see who we're talking to.
warm.TL: Dahan-dahan lang, kaibigan. Tingnan natin kung sino ang kausap.

warm.EN: Peace. Just hold up so we can get acquainted.
warm.TL: Kapayapaan. Huminto ka muna para magkakilala tayo.

warm.EN: Hello. I don't recognize your face—who might you be?
warm.TL: Kumusta. Di ko pamilyar ang mukha mo—sino ka?

warm.EN: Easy now. Just looking out for safety. Who are you?
warm.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Nag-iingat lang. Sino ka?

warm.EN: Stay there a second, stranger. Where are you heading?
warm.TL: Diyan ka muna sandali, estranghero. Saan ang punta mo?

warm.EN: Welcome, but take it slow. What's your story?
warm.TL: Maligayang pagdating, pero dahan-dahan lang. Ano ang kuwento mo?
